verdict.rationale: The evidence shows on-demand task delegation through the MCP server, with progress notifications and results returned on a thread. Nothing documents scheduling a task to run later, either once at a set time or on a recurring schedule. The 'schedule calendar events' capability is an adjacent Gmail/Outlook calendar feature, not task scheduling, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results
